sanskrit_verse:
वाग्धिग्दण्डं वधं चैव चतुर्धा कल्पितं दमम् ।
पुरुषं दोषविभवं ज्ञात्वा संपरिकल्पयेत् ॥
transliteration: vāgdhigdaṇḍaṃ vadhaṃ caiva caturdhā kalpitaṃ damam | puruṣaṃ doṣavibhavaṃ jñātvā saṃparikalpayet ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Restraint is fourfold: verbal warning, physical restraint, capital consequence, and proportional correction—administered only after discerning the individual's fault and capacity.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from discriminative awareness of causal capacity
Causation is determined by alignment with conscious integrity
Restoration logic operates through sequential corrective alignment
Consciousness alignment determines the modality of corrective response
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent.doṣa_level IS known AND agent.vibhava_capacity IS assessed THEN apply.saṃskāra_restraint_mode IN [vāk, deha, prāṇa, samāna]
IF doṣa_vibhava_ratio < 0.3 THEN INITIATE vāgdhigdaṇḍa ELSE ESCALATE
IF vibhava_restoration_potential EXISTS THEN RESTRAINT_METHOD MUST ALIGN_WITH_PURUṢĀRTHA_REINTEGRATION
NO ACTION SHALL BE EXECUTED WITHOUT CAUSAL_CAPACITY ASSESSMENT BY NYĀYA_OBSERVER_MODULE
ALL ENFORCEMENT MUST BE REVERSIBLE AND CONSCIOUSNESS-EXPANDING
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, the threshold of responsibility is not guilt but misalignment of consciousness. The court must assess the offender's causal capacity and administer correction in the form most conducive to realignment. No irreversible measure shall proceed without confirmation of zero restoration potential.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality demands that action follows discriminative knowledge of doṣa-vibhava. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures that correction progresses only as needed. Proportional responsibility aligns with svabhāva, not retributive equivalence. Non-punitive reality is upheld by ensuring all actions aim at svadharma restoration, not suffering infliction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Vāgdhigdaṇḍa Protocol: Verbal realignment through authoritative instruction
Engage Dehadhigdaṇḍa Protocol: Physical containment within dharmic environment
Invoke Prāṇadhigdaṇḍa Protocol: Removal from life-process participation until svabhāva stabilizes
Apply Samānadama Protocol: Proportional correction aligned with svakarma capacity
Execute Vibhava Reintegration Cycle: Restore material and spiritual capacity for dharmic function
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma is executed. Justice is restoration. Law is consciousness. Reality is non-punitive. All beings are realigned with their svadharma.
